div.head: Grið 26
div.ab: And la, hwilcan geþance mæg ænig man æfre huruþinga þæt don, þæt he hine on cyrican georne gebiddæ and to Godes weofedan geornlice gebuge, and ær oððon æfter, inne oððe ute, cyrican berype and wyrde oððe wanige þæt to cyrcan gebyrige?

And after all, how can anyone ever think that he may pray especially fervently in church and bow willingly to God’s altars, but before or after, within or without, pillage the church and destroy or damage that which belongs to the church?
